title: Generate-and-verify skill/MCP-tool reference docs (regenerate-and-gate, not detect-only)

deliverables.ciStep: .github/workflows/ci.yml (build-and-test → 'Verify tool & skill catalog is fresh', ubuntu-latest)

assumptions: Interpreted the gap as full-live-schema fidelity: the existing generate-docs.mjs already emits mcp-tools.md/skills-catalog.md with a --check gate, but only renders a shallow one-line-per-parameter summary, so nested/enum/required/items schema drift is invisible. The new catalog serializes each tool's ENTIRE live inputSchema and each skill's full declared contract to close that gap, rather than duplicating the existing summaries.

Built a standalone scripts/generate-tool-catalog.mjs with a generate + :check pair (mirroring generate-barrel-exports / generate-barrel-exports:check) instead of folding into generate-docs.mjs, so the new schema-drift gate is a distinct, independently reviewable CI step — matching the dsh gen-tool-catalog/verify-tool-catalog shape named in the issue.

Emitted the catalog as byte-exact deterministic output (code-point-sorted entries, deep-sorted JSON keys) and added it to .prettierignore rather than running prettier over it: prettier's embedded-JSON array formatting is non-idempotent around its print-width boundary and would make the freshness check flap. This reuses the existing .prettierignore escape hatch (roadmap serializer, empty-changeset marker).

A skill's 'schema' was taken to be its declared skill.yaml contract (name, tier, catalog_tier, type, cognitive_mode, platforms, triggers, depends_on), since skills carry no JSON input schema; drift in any of these fields now fails the build.
Wired the verify mode into BOTH CI (required by the issue) and the pre-push reference-docs freshness gate (faithful mirror of the shape the issue points at).

Linked tool-catalog.md from docs/reference/index.md but did NOT add it to the manually-curated VitePress sidebar in config.mts, matching how the sibling generated pages (mcp-tools.md, skills-catalog.md) are surfaced.
No @harness-engineering/core export was added, so scripts/generate-core-barrel.mjs allowlist needed no change.
